instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Turn the pointer moves and clicks noted beside a screen recording into zoom suggestions (where the pointer settled, for how long, how strong), as plain rows the person can edit before the video is exported", and give it sidecar.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:suggest-zooms and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give sidecar: { space: 'normalized-source', samples: [{ t (ms), type: move | click, x, y (0 to 1 of the captured source) }] }.
